verdict.rationale: RudderStack exposes APIs for programmatic access to audit logs, usage metrics, and transformation/library management, and its MCP agent can analyze across many sources at once (e.g., detecting duplicate event names across sources, reviewing tracking plans). However there is no explicit documentation of true bulk operations (batch create/update/delete across many items in a single call) for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documented multi-item write operations, and evidence of AI agents executing bulk changes rather than just read/analyze tasks.
